name: blast-sequence-step-visual
description: Redesign P4/#24: the Blast Workshop's Sequence step — delay-step stepper, Auto V-Pattern, and per-hole rows with their own +/- delay override, grouped into rows by real z coordinate.

steps.description: Setup: a fresh site. Staffed opening (#551): a driller with blasting + drill_rig licence, plus an unmanned drill_rig, are hired/purchased for free at game-open — #553's automatic drill dispatch needs both to ever land an ordered hole.

steps.command: drill_plan grid origin:10,10 rows:2 cols:2 spacing:3 depth:6
steps.description: role: bootstrap (issue #515): the Charge step right after this one is the panel's own designated first-open (`#bs-toolbar [data-panel="blast"]`, a toggle) — giving this step its own panel-open click would leave the panel open here and then CLOSE it when the charge step's click ran. #553: confirming the grid queues 4 drill_hole PendingActions and pushes 4 PlannedHoles into plannedDrillHoles — none drilled yet, so holeCount stays 0 right after confirm.

interaction.command: drill_plan grid origin:10,10 rows:2 cols:2 spacing:3 depth:6

steps.description: #553: drain the ordered plan — the staffed driller/drill_rig lands all 4 holes well inside this pad (sandbox-measured landing at tick 43).

Declared boomite/5kg/2m is exactly what the Charge panel shows on a fresh page (DEFAULT_EXPLOSIVE/DEFAULT_AMOUNT_KG/DEFAULT_STEMMING_M, Charge.ts), so Charge All commits the declared values with no stepper click at all — asserted rather than assumed. The Blast Workshop is opened here (same shape as blast-fire-step-visual.json's charge step); the step below no longer needs its own panel-open click since the panel is already open by then.
#554: drain the charge order(s) queued by the step above (charging is real work, not instant) before continuing.

The already-open Blast Workshop auto-lands on step 3 (Sequence) since drilling and charging are done but nothing is sequenced — every hole row shows an unset (—) delay. The panel is already open (opened by the charge step above), so no panel-open click here — #bs-toolbar [data-panel="blast"] is a toggle (UIManager.togglePanel), so clicking it again would have closed it.

Clicking a single hole's + override steps its delay up by the delay-step amount, live, without touching the others. adjustHoleDelay() (Sequence.ts) issues this exact command through the console bridge, so command mode replays the literal effect of the click rather than a no-op 'state' read.

expect.note: only H1 got a delay from the single +inc click, the other 3 holes stay unset

steps.description: Auto Sequence (V-Pattern) fills in every hole's delay at once, tab counter reads 4/4
